svg.title: Four memes. Expanding brain about AI permissions: give the agent the database password, write a stricter prompt, route its tool calls through the UI's permission checks, don't build a delete tool. Onboarding: no to 'send me your .env', yes to everything running on mocks. One does not simply push to main. Nobody: me at 1 a.m. writing SETUP.md with a check after every step.
svg.text: hand-drawn, because I respect copyright too

g.text: AI permissions, in four stages of enlightenment
pre-qa, then qa, then main. Always.
A setup guide nobody asked for, and everybody uses
